summary: 42-year-old woman fell ~20 ft while scrambling on the 'Sandia slabs' above the Twin Peaks trail, suffering a serious head injury; rescuers on scene within an hour and had her in an ambulance 45 minutes later to Montrose hospital.
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team; Air National Guard helicopter (recalled)
notes: Callout at noon; military helicopter was called from Eagle but stood down after the ambulance evacuation. Radio-comms difficulties in the Oak Creek canyons noted.
